Convert a SingleCellExperiment into a Seurat object

Source: R/convertSCEToSeurat.R
convertSCEToSeurat.Rd

Gives a SingleCellExperiment (read from an .rds/.qs2 file, or an AnnData file opened with readH5adAsSCE()) the shape the Seurat-based tools expect, so it can go through the Builder like any other dataset. Cells, genes, cell metadata and every reduced dimension are carried over; so are the results kept in metadata(object) (marker genes, immune repertoire, trajectories and category colours), which the export reads from @misc.

Usage

convertSCEToSeurat(
  object,
  main_assay = "RNA",
  extra_features = NULL,
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

object

A SingleCellExperiment.

main_assay

Name of the Seurat assay to create.

extra_features

Alternative experiments (altExp, for example antibody counts "ADT") whose features are added to the assay as <experiment>:<feature>: their names, or TRUE for all.

verbose

Print what was converted.

Value

A Seurat object.

Details

The expression matrix is placed by what it holds: a counts assay becomes the counts layer and logcounts the data layer. Without those, the first assay (an AnnData X) is used as counts when it holds whole numbers and as data otherwise.

Spatial coordinates (reducedDim(object, "spatial")) become one Seurat spatial image (a FOV of cell centroids) per tissue section, named after the section, so the Builder's spatial pages treat them like any other spatial data set. Sections are told apart by the library_id column. Without one the coordinates are kept as a single section. When the coordinates are the only embedding, they are also kept as the projection spatial_xy, so there is one to open the data set with.

The tissue pictures in metadata(object)$spatial_images are kept per section in @misc$cerebro_source_images (not in cerebro_spatial_images, which the export would embed in the .crb). The Builder takes them from there and attaches them to their sections as separate image files, placed at the extent their scale factor gives.

Examples

# \donttest{
sce <- readRDS(
  system.file("extdata/examples/pbmc_SCE.rds", package = "CerebroNexus")
)
seurat <- convertSCEToSeurat(sce)
seurat
#> An object of class Seurat 
#> 230 features across 80 samples within 1 assay 
#> Active assay: RNA (230 features, 0 variable features)
#>  2 layers present: counts, data
#>  2 dimensional reductions calculated: PCA, UMAP
# }
